items.title: 9.2 Cybersecurity Awareness and Threat Management (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 9.2: the text before its first sub-heading (PDF 125-126, printed 121-122).

blocks.text: Cybersecurity awareness (shaoor) ka matlab hai yeh samajhna ke computers, networks aur data ko hamlon (attacks) se kaise bachaya jaye. Jaise jaise log technology par zyada inhisar karte hain, rozmarra zindagi mein cyber threats aam ho gaye hain. Hackers maloomat churane ya systems kharab karne ke liye chalakiyan aur nuqsan-deh software use karte hain. In khatron se waqif hona users ko hoshyar rakhta hai aur woh online mehfooz tareeqe se kaam karte hain. Khatron ko pehchanna (detect), rokna (prevent) aur un ka jawab dena (respond) zaati aur idaron (organizations) ka data mehfooz rakhta hai. Misal: users ko apne computer malware aur doosre khatron se bachane ke liye antivirus software install karna chahiye. Online banking ya doosre hassas (sensitive) kaam ke liye public Wi-Fi se bhi bachna chahiye kyunke public networks mehfooz nahi bhi ho sakte.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Gandi (offensive) zaban, spam aur raaz wali (confidential) maloomat share karne se bachein.

blocks.prompt: Kitab cybersecurity awareness ki kaun si do amli misalein deti hai?
blocks.explanation: Computer ko malware se bachane ke liye antivirus software install karna, aur online banking jaise hassas (sensitive) kaam public Wi-Fi par na karna kyunke public network mehfooz nahi hota.

items: Cybersecurity awareness: computers, networks aur data ko hamlon se bachane ki samajh.
Khatron ko pehchanna, rokna aur un ka jawab dena.
